Classic radar signature of lake-effect snow across all five of the Great Lakes this evening. Fascinating meteorology at work!

If you live near the Great Lakes, you know exactly what’s happening here without needing to look at the radar. (If you don’t, it’s cloud and lake effect snow formation due to the arctic air mass passing over the warm lakes).
Shown is an MRMS radar composite of the northeastern US as bands of lake effect snow continue to affect areas downwind of the Great Lakes. TT

The ❄️ machine is on full blast in portions of northern Lake Michigan. A Winter Storm Warning is in effect until 7 AM EST. Several heavy continuous bands have set up in this flow across the lake & onto the shore.
